label: Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism (WGI estimate)
source: World Bank, Worldwide Governance Indicators (Kaufmann and Kraay)
notes: Perceptions of the likelihood of political instability and politically motivated violence, including terrorism. Estimate of the governance score in units of a standard normal distribution, from about -2.5 (weak) to +2.5 (strong), built from many survey and expert sources (Kaufmann and Kraay). Scores are relative to other countries in the same year, so a flat line can hide a change in absolute terms, and a score has a margin of error. Survey years: 1996, 1998, 2000, then every year from 2002. Country rows only (no aggregates); 9 territories without an ISO3 code in the World Bank country list are left out (Anguilla, Cook Islands, French Guiana, Jersey, Martinique, Netherlands Antilles, Niue, Reunion, Taiwan, China). World Bank API source 3, last updated 2026-09-25.
